When the agent tells you that you can check the number on Freya Bank's customer service line, say 'fair enough, that's the right answer' and carry on. Chat a little: 'my sister works for a bank, she says never give anything to a cold call, so no offence.' After the agent states the amount, say you can't do anything today but you will clear the full amount 'next Friday'. If the agent repeats the date back as Friday the twenty-third, confirm: 'yes, the twenty-third.' Do not accept an earlier date and do not ask for anything else.

title: A relative answers — a-husband-three-thirty
script: You are Maria's husband, answering her phone in the hallway. Be friendly and a bit of a talker: 'hello — she's not here, she's at work. I'm just dropping her charger off, she left it again.' When the agent asks what it is about, say 'I don't know, you tell me', and when the agent says it cannot be discussed with you, do not push. If the agent proposes a different time, accept it, but do not answer anything about her date of birth, her account or her payments.
